# `mcp-codebase` — `/api/mcp-codebase`

Self-hosted MCP JSON-RPC server exposing read-only (and one approval-gated write) codebase tools to central's tool-calling loop.

Mounted only with `ARYNWOOD_ENABLE_CODEBASE_TOOLS=1` (never in a packaged build).

| Method | Path | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| POST | [`/api/mcp-codebase`](#post-api-mcp-codebase) | Minimal MCP-over-HTTP JSON-RPC surface — tools/list and tools/call only, matching exactly what mcp_proxy.py's _mcp_post sends and _parse_mcp_response expects back (plain JSON, no SSE needed for a same-process loopback call). |

<a id="post-api-mcp-codebase"></a>
### `POST /api/mcp-codebase`

Minimal MCP-over-HTTP JSON-RPC surface — tools/list and tools/call only, matching exactly what mcp_proxy.py's _mcp_post sends and _parse_mcp_response expects back (plain JSON, no SSE needed for a same-process loopback call).

- Handler: [`mcp_codebase_rpc`](../../../backend/routers/mcp_codebase.py)
- Mounted only with `ARYNWOOD_ENABLE_CODEBASE_TOOLS=1` (never in a packaged build)
- Access: this computer only, or the API key once `ARYNWOOD_API_KEY` is set

**Response**

- `200`: JSON object with `jsonrpc`, `id`, `error` (JSON object with `code`, `message`)
- `200`: JSON object with `jsonrpc`, `id`, `error`, or JSON object with `jsonrpc`, `id`, `result`

## Tools (`tools/list`)

JSON-RPC 2.0: `{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": ..., "arguments": {...}}}`. A call's tier is the one the chat tool loop uses; a tier that needs approval is refused when called directly over HTTP (`DENIED: ...`), because approval lives in the chat and gateway tool loops. In a packaged build every call answers error -32000.

| Tool | Tier | Direct HTTP call | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`list_tree`](#tool-list-tree) | read_only | allowed | List this app's own source directory structure as a JSON tree, up to a given depth. |
| [`read_file`](#tool-read-file) | read_only | allowed | Read the text content of one file in this app's own source tree, optionally a specific line range. |
| [`search_code`](#tool-search-code) | read_only | allowed | Search this app's own source code for a literal string, across files. |
| [`find_symbol`](#tool-find-symbol) | read_only | allowed | Look up a function/class/component definition by name using a real code graph when available, falling back to a text heuristic otherwise. |
| [`git_status`](#tool-git-status) | read_only | allowed | Show this repo's current git status (porcelain format) — modified/staged/untracked files. |
| [`git_diff`](#tool-git-diff) | read_only | allowed | Show a git diff for this repo, optionally scoped to one path and/or staged changes only. |
| [`run_tests`](#tool-run-tests) | destructive | refused | Run this repo's Python test suite (pytest; the slow live-model eval tests are excluded by default), optionally scoped to one file or directory. |
| [`run_lint`](#tool-run-lint) | destructive | refused | Run this repo's frontend ESLint config. |
| [`apply_patch`](#tool-apply-patch) | destructive | refused | Apply a unified diff (as 'git diff' or 'git apply' would expect) to this repo's own source tree. |

<a id="tool-list-tree"></a>
#### `list_tree`

List this app's own source directory structure as a JSON tree, up to a given depth. Use to orient yourself before reading files — not a substitute for actually reading one.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | no |  | Relative path from the project root. Defaults to the root itself. |
| `depth` | integer | no |  | How many directory levels deep to list (1-4). Defaults to 2. |

<a id="tool-read-file"></a>
#### `read_file`

Read the text content of one file in this app's own source tree, optionally a specific line range. Max 256 KB. Always cite the file path and line numbers you actually read when answering from this.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes |  | Relative path from the project root. |
| `start_line` | integer | no |  | 1-indexed first line to include (optional). |
| `end_line` | integer | no |  | 1-indexed last line to include (optional). |

<a id="tool-search-code"></a>
#### `search_code`

Search this app's own source code for a literal string, across files. Returns file:line:text matches. Use before read_file to find where something lives.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | string | yes |  | Text to search for (literal, not a regex). |
| `path` | string | no |  | Relative path to scope the search to. Defaults to the whole project. |
| `glob` | string | no |  | Optional filename glob to restrict matches, e.g. '*.py'. |
| `max_results` | integer | no |  | Cap on returned matches. Defaults to 50. |

<a id="tool-find-symbol"></a>
#### `find_symbol`

Look up a function/class/component definition by name using a real code graph when available, falling back to a text heuristic otherwise. The result always states which mode answered — treat a heuristic match as unverified, never as confirmed.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes |  | Symbol name to look up, e.g. 'gather_context_for_message'. |

<a id="tool-git-status"></a>
#### `git_status`

Show this repo's current git status (porcelain format) — modified/staged/untracked files.

Any JSON object.

<a id="tool-git-diff"></a>
#### `git_diff`

Show a git diff for this repo, optionally scoped to one path and/or staged changes only.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | no |  | Optional relative path to scope the diff to. |
| `staged` | boolean | no |  | Show staged (--cached) changes instead of the working tree. Defaults to false. |

<a id="tool-run-tests"></a>
#### `run_tests`

Run this repo's Python test suite (pytest; the slow live-model eval tests are excluded by default), optionally scoped to one file or directory. Capped at ~12 seconds — narrow the target if a full run would exceed that.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | string | no |  | Optional relative path to a test file or directory to run instead of the whole suite. |

<a id="tool-run-lint"></a>
#### `run_lint`

Run this repo's frontend ESLint config. There is no configured Python linter in this repo. Capped at ~12 seconds — a full unscoped run reliably exceeds that on this repo's real size, so pass `target` (a specific file or directory under frontend/) to get a result that actually completes.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | string | no |  | Relative path to a specific file or directory to lint instead of the whole frontend. Recommended — an unscoped run will very likely time out. |

<a id="tool-apply-patch"></a>
#### `apply_patch`

Apply a unified diff (as 'git diff' or 'git apply' would expect) to this repo's own source tree. Every touched path must resolve inside the project root or the whole patch is rejected. Destructive — requires explicit user approval before it runs.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `diff` | string | yes |  | A unified diff with ---/+++ file headers and @@ hunks. |
